#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Test the compiler: compile each example, assemble/link it, run it, and
# compare the exit status (the program's value, mod 256) with the expectation.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

BUILD=build
COMPILER=src/compiler.py
pass=0
fail=0
mkdir -p "$BUILD"

check() {
    local name="$1" expected="$2"
    local asm="$BUILD/$name.s" exe="$BUILD/$name"

    if ! python3 "$COMPILER" "examples/$name.k" -o "$asm"; then
        echo "FAIL $name: compiler error"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
        return
    fi
    if ! gcc -Wall -o "$exe" "$asm"; then
        echo "FAIL $name: assembly/link error"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
        return
    fi

    local status=0
    "$exe" || status=$?
    if [ "$status" -eq "$expected" ]; then
        echo "PASS $name (exit $status)"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    else
        echo "FAIL $name: expected exit $expected, got $status"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi
}

check return42 42    # return 42;
check arith 14       # return 2 + 3 * 4;      (precedence)
check parens 9       # return (1 + 2) * 3;    (grouping)
check sub 5          # return 10 - 3 - 2;     (left-associative)
check division 12    # return 84 / 7;         (integer division)
check unary 252      # return -4;             (exit statuses are mod 256)

# Negative test: invalid source must be rejected with a nonzero exit.
if python3 "$COMPILER" examples/bad.k -o "$BUILD/bad.s" 2>"$BUILD/bad.err"; then
    echo "FAIL bad.k: compiler accepted invalid input"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
else
    echo "PASS bad.k (rejected: $(cat "$BUILD/bad.err"))"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
fi

# --- As-of evidence snapshot tests --------------------------------------------
SNAP_TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$SNAP_TMP"' EXIT

AS_OF="2026-04-01T10:00:00Z"

if python3 tools/snapshot.py create --as-of "$AS_OF" -o "$SNAP_TMP/snapshots" >"$SNAP_TMP/create.log" 2>&1; then
    echo "PASS snapshot create (as-of $AS_OF)"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
    SNAP="$SNAP_TMP/snapshots/20260401T100000Z"

    expected_hash=$(sha256sum src/compiler.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
    if recorded=$(python3 -c "
import json
m = json.load(open('$SNAP/manifest.json'))
r = next(f for f in m['files'] if f['path'] == 'src/compiler.py')
print(m['as_of'], r['sha256'])
") && [ "$recorded" = "$AS_OF $expected_hash" ]; then
        echo "PASS snapshot manifest (as-of + compiler.py content hash)"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    else
        echo "FAIL snapshot manifest: recorded '$recorded', expected '$AS_OF $expected_hash'"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi

    if python3 tools/snapshot.py verify "$SNAP" >"$SNAP_TMP/verify.log" 2>&1; then
        echo "PASS snapshot verify (intact)"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    else
        echo "FAIL snapshot verify: $(cat "$SNAP_TMP/verify.log")"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    fi

    printf 'X' >>"$SNAP/files/examples/arith.k"
    if python3 tools/snapshot.py verify "$SNAP" >"$SNAP_TMP/verify-tamper.log" 2>&1; then
        echo "FAIL snapshot tamper: verify accepted modified content"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    else
        echo "PASS snapshot tamper detection (stored content)"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    fi

    printf 'X' >>"$SNAP/manifest.json"
    if python3 tools/snapshot.py verify "$SNAP" >"$SNAP_TMP/verify-manifest-tamper.log" 2>&1; then
        echo "FAIL snapshot tamper: verify accepted modified manifest"
        fail=$((fail + 1))
    else
        echo "PASS snapshot tamper detection (manifest)"
        pass=$((pass + 1))
    fi
else
    echo "FAIL snapshot create: $(cat "$SNAP_TMP/create.log")"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
fi

echo
echo "$pass passed, $fail failed"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
